procedure: State: The same candidate table and calibrated route measurements describe a regression with hidden stage contributions. Procedure: Use the candidate/test matrix. Compare the observed totals of all three known routes with sums predicted by candidate nonnegative stage contributions, adjust those contributions to fit, and retain every assignment consistent with the measurement bounds. Limits and stopping conditions: The calibrated additive regime, route coverage, error and non-uniqueness bound the inference. A contribution interval containing zero cannot establish a nonzero contribution.

observables: Across-route discrepancies and the set of stage contributions compatible with all measured totals.
inferential_warrant: Compatibility across overlapping routes constrains hidden stage contributions even without direct stage counters. Map constrained stages to their associated deployed changes as bounded candidate contribution evidence; do not infer a unique live cause.
problem_decomposition: Keep ordinary deployed-change alternatives; stage variables are the operands required by the one inverse-constraint rule.
next_inquiry: Use the same ordinary old/new replay or rollback confirmation for an implicated change; no new adaptive acquisition rule is added.
